Ram Temple Trust Appoints First CEO Amid Administrative Changes

The Ram Temple Trust has appointed Air Marshal (Retd) Jeetendra Mishra as its first Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Govind Dev Giri will serve as the full-time general secretary, and businessman Mahesh Bhagchandka has been appointed treasurer. These appointments come amid discussions about administrative reforms and transparency within the Trust. The Trust also reportedly discussed the appointment of a Public Relations Officer (PRO) and filling vacant posts.
